description_en: A kneeling chair with separate sloped woven seat and padded knee rest on a triangular bamboo frame; the front shows the lower knee pad, the side reveals the two distinct support angles, and the rear shows the narrow seat platform and diagonal connecting struts. Show this single complete furniture object alone on a plain studio background. All surfaces, hardware and panels must be unmarked, with no letters, numbers, logos, labels, captions or watermarks.
